```{=html}
<p>
\[
\begin{aligned}

\text{WOA}_i &= \begin{cases} 
    \begin{array}{l}
    1 &\text{ with } p = \eta_{A_i} \\
    0 &\text{ with } p = \eta_{D_i} \\
    c &\text{ with } p = 1 - \eta_{A_i} - \eta_{D_i}
    \end{array} 
\end{cases} && \note{probabilities for each outcome}\\

\text{logit}(\eta_{A_i}) &= \alpha_{\eta_A} + \alpha_{\eta_{A_{j[i]}}} + \alpha_{\eta_{A_{k[i]}}} && \note{logit models with random effects} \\
\text{logit}(\eta_{D_i}) &= \alpha_{\eta_D} + \alpha_{\eta_{D_{j[i]}}} + \alpha_{\eta_{D_{k[i]}}}  \\

[\alpha_{\eta_{A_{j[i]}}}, \alpha_{\eta_{A_{k[i]}}}] 
&\sim Normal(0, \ 
[\sigma_{\eta_{A_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{A_{k[i]}}}) && \note{random effect distributions for logit} \\

[\alpha_{\eta_{D_{j[i]}}}, \alpha_{\eta_{D_{k[i]}}}] 
&\sim Normal(0, \ 
[\sigma_{\eta_{D_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\eta_{D_{k[i]}}}) \\

c &\sim Beta(\mu_{C_i} \phi_{C_i}, (1 - \mu_{C_i}) \phi_{C_i}) && \note{continuous component for compromise} \\

\mu_{C_i} &= \alpha_{\mu_C} + \alpha_{\mu_{C_{j[i]}}} + \alpha_{\mu_{C_{k[i]}}} && \note{linear model for each Beta parameter} \\

\phi_{C_i} &= \alpha_{\phi_C} + \alpha_{\phi_{C_{j[i]}}} + \alpha_{\phi_{C_{k[i]}}} \\

[\alpha_{\mu_{C_{j[i]}}}, \alpha_{\mu_{C_{k[i]}}}] 
&\sim Normal(0, \
[\sigma_{\mu_{C_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\mu_{C_{k[i]}}}) && \note{random effect distributions for Beta} \\

[\alpha_{\phi_{C_{j[i]}}}, \alpha_{\phi_{C_{k[i]}}}] 
&\sim Normal(0, 
[\sigma_{\phi_{C_{j[i]}}}, \sigma_{\phi_{C_{k[i]}}}])

\end{aligned}
\]
</p>
```
